skill.name: pr
skill.description: Creates structured GitHub pull requests for specification review and implementation review in an SDD workflow.
skill.summary: Creates review-ready spec and implementation pull requests for SDD projects.
skill.author: Clionegohan

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, examples, and documentation links. Two external-command findings are confirmed because the skill directs git and GitHub CLI commands that can commit, push, and create pull requests. One semantic issue notes that broad git staging can publish unrelated or sensitive files.

remediation.issue: External Git and GitHub CLI commands can publish repository changes.
remediation.suggestion: Show the exact commands and affected files before running push or PR creation. Require explicit user confirmation for each publishing step.

remediation.issue: The workflow uses broad staging with git add .
remediation.suggestion: Stage only reviewed files, or ask the user to approve the file list before committing.

remediation.issue: The skill depends on authenticated GitHub CLI access.
remediation.suggestion: Document required permissions and avoid requesting authentication unless the user starts PR creation.

semantic_findings.title: Broad Git Staging Can Publish Unintended Files
semantic_findings.description: The command sequence uses git add . before commit and push. This can stage unrelated files or secrets if the workspace is not clean.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The skill explicitly recommends broad staging before pushing to a remote branch. The surrounding workflow is legitimate, but the command scope creates a real publication risk.

content.value_statement: Manual PR preparation can miss context, tests, or review focus. This skill builds structured spec and implementation PR drafts for SDD workflows.
actual_capabilities: Creates spec and implementation PR titles with clear prefixes.
Builds PR body templates for specification review and implementation review.
Checks git status and git diff before preparing a pull request.
Guides commit, push, and GitHub CLI PR creation steps.
Handles no-change, existing-PR, and unauthenticated GitHub CLI cases.
limitations: Requires a Git repository and GitHub CLI access.
Designed for SDD workflows that use spec and implementation phases.
Does not replace code review, test execution, or branch protection.
Broad staging commands can include unrelated workspace files.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Specification Review PR
use_cases.description: Create a PR that summarizes generated specification files and highlights review criteria.

use_cases.title: Open an Implementation Review PR
use_cases.description: Draft an implementation PR with change summary, test plan, and acceptance criteria status.

use_cases.title: Standardize SDD Pull Requests
use_cases.description: Use consistent PR titles and body sections across a team workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic PR
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner workflow for the current branch.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an implementation PR for the current branch. Use main as the base branch and ask before creating it.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Spec Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Specification review after SDD files are generated.
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a spec review PR for this action. Summarize generated spec files and include review focus items.

prompt_templates.title: Review Before Publishing
prompt_templates.scenario: Safer workflow before pushing or creating a PR.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the working tree and draft the PR title and body. Show staged files and wait for confirmation before publishing.

prompt_templates.title: Handle Existing Branch State
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow when a branch may already have a PR.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create or update the implementation PR for this branch. Detect any existing PR and ask whether to update it or create a new one.

output_examples.input: Create an implementation PR for the current branch.
output_examples.output: The skill reviews local changes, proposes an impl title, drafts a summary and test plan, then asks before creating the PR.

output_examples.input: Prepare a spec review PR for action 001-01-01.
output_examples.output: The skill creates a spec title, lists generated specification files, and adds review questions for user stories and acceptance criteria.

output_examples.input: Create a PR when the branch already has one.
output_examples.output: The skill reports that a PR already exists and asks whether to update it or start a new PR.

best_practices: Review git status and diff before staging files.
Confirm the PR title, body, base branch, and changed files before publishing.
Run required tests before creating an implementation PR.
anti_patterns: Creating a pull request without explicit user approval.
Using broad staging when the workspace contains unrelated files.
Opening an implementation PR before tests or acceptance criteria are checked.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates structured GitHub pull requests for specification review and implementation review.

faq.question: Does it support Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatibility.

faq.question: Does it require GitHub CLI?
faq.answer: Yes. PR creation depends on GitHub CLI commands and authentication.

faq.question: Can it create PRs without confirmation?
faq.answer: No. The skill states that PR creation without user confirmation is prohibited.

faq.question: What PR types are supported?
faq.answer: It supports spec PRs for specification review and impl PRs for implementation review.

faq.question: What should users check first?
faq.answer: Users should review changed files, test status, the base branch, and the generated PR body.
